examples.english: Throughout history, oppressive rule has often triggered popular uprisings.

notes:
A literary and historical term for cruel, burdensome governance. Most famously known from the Chinese classical saying {苛政|かせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{虎|とら}→虎：02228_tora⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{猛|たけ}し ("Oppressive government is fiercer than a tiger"), attributed to Confucius.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {苛政|かせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しむ→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧: to suffer under oppressive rule
- {苛政|かせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to impose harsh rule
- {苛政|かせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{虎|とら}→虎：02228_tora⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{猛|たけ}し: oppressive government is fiercer than a tiger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暴政|ぼうせい}→暴政：24165_bousei⟧: tyranny — emphasizes the violent and cruel nature of the rule
- ⟦{圧政|あっせい}→圧政：12133_assei⟧: oppression — emphasizes the weight and pressure of authoritarian governance
- {悪政|あくせい}: misgovernment — broader term for bad governance, not necessarily cruel
